Baptised 11 December 1705 at Bammental, near Heidelberg.
Married Anna Margaretha Strep at Meckesheim on 16 January 1732, and that September they landed at Philadelphia from
the ship Pleasant. They farmed near Frederick, Maryland, where their son Johann Jacob was born in 1735.
She married Johann Caspar Wenderoth there on 16 January 1732, and that September they landed at Philadelphia from
the ship Pleasant. They lived about two years near New London, Pennsylvania, then farmed outside Frederick,
Maryland, where their son Johann Jacob was born in 1735.
